WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT "entity", "year", "internet_users"
  FROM internet_users_data
), lag1 AS (
  SELECT "entity", "year", "internet_users",
         LAG("internet_users") OVER (PARTITION BY "entity" ORDER BY "year") AS prev1
  FROM yearly
), lag2 AS (
  SELECT "entity", "year", "internet_users", prev1,
         LAG(prev1) OVER (PARTITION BY "entity" ORDER BY "year") AS prev2
  FROM lag1
), growth AS (
  SELECT "entity", "year",
         prev2 AS start_val,
         "internet_users" AS end_val
  FROM lag2
  WHERE prev2 IS NOT NULL AND prev2 > 0
    AND ("internet_users" - prev2) / prev2 > 0.5
)
SELECT DISTINCT "entity"
FROM growth
ORDER BY "entity";

    FROM toy_sales ts
    JOIN toy_products tp ON ts."Product_ID" = tp."Product_ID"
    WHERE ts."Date"::"Date" >= (tstore."Store_Open_Date"::"Date" + INTERVAL '3 years')

    SELECT ti."Store_ID",

    FROM toy_inventory ti
    JOIN toy_products tp ON ti."Product_ID" = tp."Product_ID"
    WHERE ti."Store_ID" IN (SELECT "Store_ID" FROM store_sales)
    GROUP BY ti."Store_ID"
),

    SELECT ss."Store_ID",
           CASE WHEN ai.avg_inv_cost > 0 THEN ss.total_cogs / ai.avg_inv_cost ELSE NULL END AS turnover

)

),
store_turnover AS (
    SELECT ss."Store_ID",
           CASE WHEN ai.avg_inv_cost > 0 THEN ss.total_cogs / ai.avg_inv_cost ELSE NULL END AS turnover
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN avg_inventory ai ON ss."Store_ID" = ai."Store_ID"
)
SELECT tstore."Store_Name"
FROM toy_stores tstore
JOIN store_turnover st ON tstore."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"

    SELECT AVG(st2.turnover)
    FROM store_turnover st2
)
ORDER BY tstore."Store_Name";

WITH fraud_tx AS (
    SELECT t."Transaction_ID", t."Credit_Card_ID", t."Transaction_Value", c."Cust_ID", c."Credit_Limit",
           CAST(t."Transaction_Value" AS numeric) / NULLIF(c."Credit_Limit", 0) AS usage_ratio
    FROM credit_card_transaction_base t
    JOIN credit_card_fraud_base f ON f."Transaction_ID" = t."Transaction_ID"
    JOIN credit_card_card_base c ON c."Card_Number" = t."Credit_Card_ID"
    WHERE f."Fraud_Flag" = 1
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT "Cust_ID", AVG(usage_ratio) AS avg_usage_ratio
    FROM fraud_tx
    GROUP BY "Cust_ID"
)
SELECT "Cust_ID", avg_usage_ratio,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_usage_ratio DESC, "Cust_ID" ASC) AS rank
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY rank ASC;

)

    ),
    subject AS (
      SELECT "SubjectID"
      FROM school_subjects
      WHERE LOWER("SubjectName") = LOWER('斯瓦希里语')
    ),
    eligible_marks AS (
      SELECT m."MarkObtained"
      FROM school_marks m
      JOIN teacher t ON m."TeacherID" = t."TeacherID"
      JOIN subject s ON m."SubjectID" = s."SubjectID"
    ),
    avg_mark AS (
      SELECT AVG("MarkObtained") AS avg_score
      FROM eligible_marks

    SELECT s."StudentID", s."FirstName", s."LastName", m."ExamDate", m."MarkObtained"

    JOIN school_marks m ON m."MarkObtained" = em."MarkObtained"
    JOIN school_students s ON m."StudentID" = s."StudentID"

    WHERE m."MarkObtained" > a.avg_score
    ORDER BY m."MarkObtained" DESC, s."StudentID";

    FROM alcohol_life_expectancy_verbose
    WHERE "RegionDisplay" = 'Europe'

),
ranked AS (

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        "company",
        "country",
        Valuation_num,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "country" ORDER BY Valuation_num DESC, "company" ASC) AS rnk
    FROM (
        SELECT
            "company",
            "country",
            CASE
                WHEN "valuation" SIMILAR TO '[0-9]+' THEN CAST("valuation" AS numeric)
                WHEN "valuation" LIKE '%B' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("valuation", '$', ''), 'B', '') AS numeric) * 1000000000
                WHEN "valuation" LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("valuation", '$', ''), 'M', '') AS numeric) * 1000000
                ELSE NULL
            END AS Valuation_num
        FROM unicorns_data
        WHERE "valuation" IS NOT NULL
    ) t
),
country_total AS (
    SELECT
        "country",
        SUM(Valuation_num) AS total_valuation
    FROM (
        SELECT
            "country",
            CASE
                WHEN "valuation" SIMILAR TO '[0-9]+' THEN CAST("valuation" AS numeric)
                WHEN "valuation" LIKE '%B' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("valuation", '$', ''), 'B', '') AS numeric) * 1000000000
                WHEN "valuation" LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("valuation", '$', ''), 'M', '') AS numeric) * 1000000
                ELSE NULL
            END AS Valuation_num
        FROM unicorns_data
        WHERE "valuation" IS NOT NULL
    ) t
    GROUP BY "country"
)
SELECT
    r."country",
    r."company",
    ROUND((r.Valuation_num / ct.total_valuation) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM ranked r
JOIN country_total ct ON r."country" = ct."country"
WHERE r.rnk <= 3
ORDER BY r."country" ASC, r.rnk ASC, r."company" ASC;
